PROJECTS
CampusRoute - Accessible Campus Navigation
Built a React and Python route planner for accessible campus paths. Modelled route segments in PostgreSQL, implemented keyboard navigation, and wrote unit tests for route selection. The project compared travel distance with accessibility preferences and explained when a requested route could not be found.
InterviewJournal - Practice Reflection Tool
Developed an interview reflection dashboard with private notes and an application tracker. Implemented server-side input validation, a stable demo account and regression tests for persistence across server restarts. Clearly separated deterministic matching from generated coaching suggestions.
